label: D2 after a2 -> S2 common, early in the episode
explanation: Fires at D2 (85% of mass) when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by a common transition (in_state=2, in_action=2), and mostly when the previous trial was not rare. Never fires at D1 or on any rewarded-input step; S1 arrivals and rare transitions almost never trigger it. A second, weaker component (about 15% of mass) is at GO, mostly on trials where the agent chooses a1. Activity fades strongly with episode time: rate is about 15% of steps in trials 0-9, about 4% in trials 40-49, and zero after trial 70. This is why ep_trial < 50 is needed (the agent can only track elapsed time implicitly). Activation is higher where the value head is high. All variables are observable at D2. Dev F1 0.72 (P 0.72, R 0.72). Leaving out the GO component and the soft time decay limits recall and precision.
